title: Image.load_from_file does not load DDS files
body:
### Tested versions

v4.5.1.stable.steam [f62fdbde1], and master branch 235a32ad11f40ecba26d6d9ceea8ab245c13adb0

### System information

Windows 10, see above for Godot versions, happens with all renderers.

### Issue description

Executing `Image.load_from_file("/path/to/image.dds")` fails with error 15, unrecognized. This is somewhat unexpected, as other formats supported by the Image class (e.g. BMP, TGA, JPG, etc) all work, and using `Image.load_dds_from_buffer()` with the same DDS file loaded using `FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes()` works fine.

I guess either the documentation should be more explicit about what formats are supported by `Image.load_from_file` or DDS support should be added.

At my first glance it seems that all supported formats are implemented through `ImageLoader` while DDS support is implemented through `ResourceFormatLoader`. Interestingly, it does have a `ImageSaver` implementation it seems 🤔 

In any case, I'm willing to create a PR if we can agree upon what it should look like 😉 

### Steps to reproduce

Simply try and load a DDS file using `Image.load_from_file()`, and see it fail with error 15.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[load-from-file-fail.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23690709/load-from-file-fail.zip)

Error copied from console:

```
E 0:00:01:166   texture_rect.gd:6 @ _ready(): Failed to load image. Error 15
  <C++ Error>   Method/function failed. Returning: Ref<Image>()
  <C++ Source>  core/io/image.cpp:2548 @ load_from_file()
  <Stack Trace> texture_rect.gd:6 @ _ready()
```
